theorems.name: Submission.constancy_riesz_l1_dual_bounded_density
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α), IsFiniteMeasure μ → ∀ (F : (α → ℝ) → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ f g : α → ℝ, Integrable f μ → Integrable g μ → F (f + g) = F f + F g) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ), Integrable f μ → F (c • f) = c * F f) → (∀ f : α → ℝ, Integrable f μ → |F f| ≤ C * ∫ x, |f x| ∂μ) → ∃ θ : α → ℝ, Measurable θ ∧ (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x, |θ x| ≤ M) ∧ ∀ f : α → ℝ, Integrable f μ → F f = ∫ x, f x * θ x ∂μ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
